overview: Built an automated system for creating deal specific landing pages for real estate investment opportunities.
The system collects structured deal information, generates a dedicated landing page, stores the deal data, and distributes the opportunity to investors or internal teams.

blocks.p: The system supports five investment strategies:
Each strategy has its own dynamic form and captures the relevant property and financial information, including:
Once a deal is submitted, the system:

list: Populates the page with the submitted deal information
Presents the opportunity in a consistent format for investors

blocks.p: All submitted deals are stored in Google Sheets for tracking and management.
New deals can then be automatically shared with investors, partners, or internal teams through connected notification and communication channels.

result: A scalable deal publishing system that removes manual landing page creation, standardizes deal presentation, keeps deal information organized, and allows new investment opportunities to be published and shared quickly.
